attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"forcing farmers to wait until next week for grain supplies","reason":"Briefing gives no timeline or grain-supply consequence for the market closure."},{"span":"Scythe Tooth pirates have been spotted patrolling the southern border of the colony again","reason":"No such sighting, southern border or patrol is in the briefing; it also re-presents old raid news as new."},{"span":"leaving many settlements hungry","reason":"Hunger is not stated in the briefing."},{"span":"despite the Gorse Clans' usual trade deals","reason":"Adds an unsupported detail about the Clans' usual trade arrangements."}],"voice":1,"clarity":2,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It copies the briefing's section headings into the bulletin, which breaks character.
